value.rationale: The projective dual degree counts tangent hyperplanes in a general pencil and is a standard discriminant complexity. Fixing \(d+e\) fixes the adjunction coefficient \(K_X\cong\mathcal O_X(d+e-6)\), making the cross-bidegree comparison natural. The result gives a complete structural classification, an unexpected \(\sqrt q\)-scale imbalance, and an infinite exact tie sequence, rather than an arbitrary finite slice or routine recomputation.
